data.narrative:
Armadin operates in Defense & Security, a sector populated by 26 peer companies across public and private markets. The comparable universe includes 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private peers. Within this landscape, Armadin's closest identifiable peers include Anduril Industries, Helsing, Castelion, Shield AI, and Saronic—all private frontier-tech players in adjacent mission spaces.

Peer-median valuation methodology cannot be reliably applied to Armadin. The Defense & Security sector lacks a sufficient narrow-stage cohort: zero same-stage comparables, zero adjacent-stage comparables, and zero similar-valuation-tier peers yielded datapoints meeting the minimum three-company threshold for statistical validity. While 26 same-sector companies exist, applying an all-sector median would introduce excessive dispersion bias given the heterogeneity of company maturity, technology readiness, and capital intensity within defense technology.

Without triangulated valuation results from peer multiples, revenue-multiple methods, or DCF calibration, this analysis cannot support a specific valuation range. The primary uncertainty is the absence of disclosed financial metrics for Armadin and misalignment between company stage and comparable-company maturity. Future valuation work should target disclosure of Armadin's revenue run rate, customer concentration, and capital deployment to enable more granular peer selection and multiple-based benchmarking against the Anduril/Helsing cohort.
